Batch 32 authoring is complete. The A/B pages are frontmatter-only, the four item statements match the batch manifest, and the contracts, coverage, cross-batch records, notes, and Step 1 records are in place. See the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-32.notes.md>).

The latter page edge remains open. A later batch-31 manifest refresh made the three escalation records’ input hashes stale; I rechecked the current suppliers and left those escalations untouched.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (4 items, 11 steps), strict contracts (4/4), precheck, rendering, content policy, dependency checks, and source-fetch verification. Assigned dependency levels recalculate to 3, 4, 5, and 5. Run-wide checks remain blocked by 30 empty scaffold inventories elsewhere; the statement-first check stops at batch 34.

I also corrected the graph proof to count internal chiral matter lines. The source’s following case enumeration appears to say \(\mathcal C_2=2\), while its count equation forces \(\mathcal C_2=1\); this discrepancy is documented in the proof and batch evidence. ([Weinberg’s paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9803099))
